Impact & research

Impact Pathway Canvas
Download PDF guide

Interactive impact-planning prototype

Make the route from research to real-world change visible.

Build an impact pathway by linking a research finding to the people who matter, the engagement activity that could enable use, the change you intend to contribute to, and the evidence needed to make a responsible claim later.

!
A pathway is a hypothesis, not proof of impact. It helps a team test whether the finding is relevant, whether people can use it, what engagement is appropriate, and what evidence should be captured as activity unfolds.

Add a pathway card

Create cards, connect each one to a preceding point in the pathway, then drag cards on the canvas to organise the story visually.

Connections describe a plausible contribution pathway. They do not establish causation or prove later impact.

Impact pathway

Drag cards to organise the map. Click a card to inspect its contribution, owner and evidence or assumption.

Impact-plan review prompts

    This tool supports planning, facilitation and structured reflection. It does not prove causation, guarantee impact, validate evidence, replace ethical review or determine REF eligibility. Review pathways with intended users and affected communities, and record engagement and evidence as the work happens rather than reconstructing it afterwards.
